nodes.title: Detailer Note
widgets_values:
The detailer subgraph is designed to basically just be copy/pasted pretty easily, the only connection that needs to be made is linking up the image output and input and to the seed node here.

There is logic to detect if the detailer model in usage is a segm model, which entirely mitigates the need to connect up the SEGM input. There is no logic for SAM models, so that needs to be handled manually.

When "use_alt_prompt" is true, simply put in a new prompt into the "value" multiline string. It will be concatenated as such: [artist tags, gentags, quality tags] just like the initial prompt, thus, there is no need to worry about artist tags or quality tags here.

nodes.title: Samplers Note
widgets_values:
Right off the bat: ensure that the Color Corrector node is OFF if you are using a batch size larger than 1.

Select true for HiresFix Type to perform a pixel HiresFix, select false to leave it as a latent HiresFix. The former may be higher quality, the latter can be faster.

The value for cfg_pp should be around 1.0 to 1.7 for non DPM CFG++ samplers, and around 2.0 to 3.0 for DPM CFG++ samplers.
